text:
lena: Quick post-mortem from this morning's int4 rollout: we're seeing a reproducible uptick in hallucinations and numeric drift on the deid-longform-plus holdout. Not catastrophic but consistent across runs. Need a curated microgolden and a coordinated labeling plan.

omar: can you share the eval snippet and worst slices?

lena: pasted:
```
$ rbin eval --model rbin-q4b-1.0 --dataset deid-longform-plus --slices long_summaries,numeric_lists
ROUGE-L: 34.7
Hallucination-rate: 8.0% (+2.9% vs fp16)
Numeric-exact-match: 87.2% (-5.0%)
Latency p50: 218ms
```

sara: hmm. any quick ablates (kv-cache, batching)?

lena: tried kv-cache off -> hallu down 0.2%. Main signal points to attention quant path and one kernel permutation. I also saw more errors on prompts with multi-line enumerations and embedded tables.

kai: treat as a regression. Proposal: assemble a focused microgolden of 320 items: 180 long summaries (>=900 tokens), 80 numeric/table cases, 60 adversarial paraphrases targeting numbers/entities. 3 labelers per example, validator on disagreements.

omar: sampling/dedupe plan: pull 1.5k candidates from last 45 days of deid RAG traffic -> compute 3-gram shingle fuzzy dedupe -> remove matches in existing golden/microgolden by md5_text -> surface 500 candidates -> labeler queue -> finalize 320. We'll attach provenance: source_ts, session_id, route, md5_text, shingle_hash.

sara: labeler checklist (ops copy):
1) Confirm the model output only uses content present in the source.
2) For numbers: check numeric token matches exactly; for tables, verify each cell present.
3) If the model invents content, mark 'hallucination' and include the smallest evidence span.
4) Severity 0-3. Escalate unmasked PII to privacy-ops.

labeler-bot: New labeling job LB-11011 created for ticket ML-9900. Estimated first-pass ETA: 72 hrs.

lena: on the model side I want a reproducible quant/kern sweep to isolate the kernel+permute combination. Nora-style command example: 
```
rbin quant-sweep --model rbin-q4b-1.0 --bits 4 --kernels aten,flash,fast_attn --permute none,block --kv-cache on,off --eval deid-longform-plus --save ML-9900/logs
```

kai: if we find a single kernel combo that recovers EM and lowers hallucination, we can either pin kernel selection for the model or add a per-route override. If no single combo helps, try per-layer exceptions (keep attn/layernorm fp16). Also update Optimize with a 'longform-int4' profile recommending those exceptions.

sara: console ops: let's also add a small dashboard tile "deid-longform-plus: longform-hallu & numeric-em" tracking hallu-rate and numeric-exact-match on golden vs prod slices, with alerting for >2% regression.

omar: I'll start candidate extraction and run dedupe now, push artifacts to ML-9900/artifacts, and populate LB-11011.

labeler-bot: LB-11011 staged with 500 candidates; awaiting labeler assignment.

lena: action items recap: (1) lena file ML-9900 + attach eval and open console card, (2) omar assemble candidates + dedupe + populate LB-11011, (3) sara run model/kernel sweep and upload logs to ML-9900, (4) labelers run LB-11011 and finalize microgolden. Ping here if blocked. :white_check_mark:
